channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Commons
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Commons (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons: The note on Mission Bay Commons now lists all the expected dates for the planned rebuild of its western parcels: construction late 2028 and opening early 2030 on Rec & Park's schedule, with the same page also saying the parks are 'anticipated to be complete by 2028' and OCII listing a transfer to Rec & Park at the end of 2028. These are expected dates, and the sources differ.
item.description: The note on Mission Bay Commons now lists all the expected dates for the planned rebuild of its western parcels: construction late 2028 and opening early 2030 on Rec & Park's schedule, with the same page also saying the parks are 'anticipated to be complete by 2028' and OCII listing a transfer to Rec & Park at the end of 2028. These are expected dates, and the sources differ. Source: SF Recreation and Park Department, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project); OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, November 14, 2024, timeline slide (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons: The map notes gave build years (P17 2002, P16 2010, P11 2015) that neither cited OCII source states and that conflict with a 2011 EPA release, so they were removed. The 2028-2030 future-parks window now cites SF Rec & Park's project page, the claim that the parks were completed under the 1998 plan was reduced to what OCII's deck says, the record's P16 milestone now cites OCII's November 2024 legend and says which segment is unconfirmed, and the summary uses the Rec & Park page's own address and wording. The Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.

item.title: Complete · Mission Bay Commons: Park P16 -- one of the completed eastern segments (P16 and P17) of the Mission Bay Commons strip in OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update legend, between 3rd St and Terry Francois Blvd; which of the two this record's mapped lawn is, is not confirmed -- described in a Nov 2011 EPA release as "the newest segment of the Mission Bay Commons Park system" and "recently completed" as of this date, funded partly by a DTSC brownfields grant (~2011)
